designer_statement_note: The rulebook is Jaye Wiley's own primary statement of the rules, written in first person throughout (the Introduction, page-14 gang-building framing, and closing notes on p.3 all speak directly as the designer).

extraction_method.reason: Clean embedded text layer confirmed: median 2539 chars/page across 62 pages, 0 pages requiring OCR fallback.
extraction_method.encoding_check: Full extraction scanned for U+FFFD (replacement character): 0 found across all 62 pages. Non-ASCII characters present are legitimate typographic Unicode already correctly decoded by PyMuPDF (copyright sign U+00A9, en dash U+2013, left/right single and double smart quotes U+2018/U+2019/U+201C/U+201D, bullet U+2022) -- these render as '?' in a cp1252 terminal but are not corruption.
extraction_method.weapons_table_note: The Weapons table (printed p.30-31) extracts as three separate column blocks (Name / Range / Notes) rather than row-aligned text, a known PyMuPDF layout artifact on multi-column tables. Reconstructed as a single markdown table in source.md by manual row-matching, cross-checked against the prose weapon descriptions on p.31-33 (10 of 18 rows independently confirmed word-for-word against prose; the remaining 8 follow the same pattern with no contradicting prose). Flagged inline in source.md as reconstructed, not raw-extracted.

capture_contents.source.md: Full 62-page verbatim text capture, page by page, plus the reconstructed Weapons table.
